name: filmcraft
description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written from scratch in pure Rust

issues.title: Hardware acceleration: GPU/media-engine decode, GPU effects and GPU export
Feature request: Link EffectCraft compositions directly into FilmCraft with headless rendering
Windows: GPU export silently renders on the CPU (export instance takes DX12, FXC fails on `fx`)
Possibility to open or import existing Premiere Projects? And what about presets?
The interface cannot be switched to Chinese.
Report: a real-world corpus run of 92 video files against 0.7.2 and 0.8.0 — probe accuracy, source frames vs ffmpeg, export check

latest_release.name: FilmCraft v0.20.1
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* render: refuse mixer graphs whose latency or compensation delays are absurd by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4225
* audio-dsp: validate stored remix plans so pieces cannot stack on one output by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4104
* ci: run Harden-Runner on every job by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4672
* export: OpenEXR ZIP/ZIPS reuses the deflate hash tables across a frame's chunks (#4659) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4666
* engine, ui: default screenshot, session log and voice-over folders go in a private temp folder by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4264
* Updates: take craft-update from craft-libs main at 6e03f65bf by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4675
* tests: write artifacts into a fresh private temp folder instead of a predictable name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4260
* codecs: bound the search for a random-access sample and honour cancellation in it by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4229
* Fix Flatpak updates and bump to 0.20.1 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4678
* audio: bound project-driven buffer sizes before allocating by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4170
* codecs: evict interior GOP cache frames when both ends are protected by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4187
* CI: nightly release dry run by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4684
* Audio codecs and Ogg come from craft-libs by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4676

## New Contributors
* @wanikhawar made their first contribution in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4666

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/compare/v0.20.0...v0.20.1
